title: Force UTF-8 for Unicode-bearing proposal audits
failure_signature: A proposal-keyword audit hit a Windows cp1252 UnicodeEncodeError while printing a prior Maori-bearing title.
candidate_workaround: Use explicit UTF-8 process output for Unicode-bearing repository audits while keeping files encoded as UTF-8 with LF.
recurrence_guard: Set UTF-8 before printing proposal, authority, or cultural-language text on Windows.
rollback: Write a sanitized UTF-8 receipt file or stop; never transliterate authority-bearing terms merely to satisfy a console.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
